dialogues.speaker: Yuan Hong
dialogues.text: The tree who stands alone has no forest to call his home...

dialogues.speaker: Yuan Hong
dialogues.text: The splendid red autumnal leaves, parted ways though there be no breeze...

dialogues.speaker: Yuan Hong
dialogues.text: The glorious red autumnal leaves, parted ways on a passing breeze...

dialogues.speaker: Yuan Hong
dialogues.text: Money... riches... It's all a farce. A farce, I say!

dialogues.speaker: Yuan Hong
dialogues.text: The further away from this village... the better...

dialogues.speaker: Yuan Hong
dialogues.text: If only we could start all over again... From the beginning...
